title: Not every externship posting is an open job (talent pools; SHN Nov 30 example)

brief.problem: Students treat every extern posting as an open job. A talent-pool posting collects candidates for upcoming vacancies; misreading it skews where they put their effort.
hooks: scarborough health's extern talent pool closes nov 30
not every externship posting means there's an open job
'talent pool' on an extern posting: what it actually means
nursing students, read this before applying to a talent pool
the extern posting word that trips up nursing students
applying to a talent pool? here's what it is (and isn't)
brief.why: The v1 hook only works for someone already looking at SHN. This one names a misconception any nursing student can have, anywhere, and slides 2-4 pay it off: the situation, what a talent pool is (in the posting's own words), and what that means for applying. SHN arrives on slide 5 as the real Ontario example; its Nov 30 date stays on the cover as a secondary callout. Rejected: 'trips up' (claims a reaction we have no evidence for); 'read this before applying' (generic); the question form (weaker than a direct statement).
brief.payoff: The reader can tell a talent pool from an open position, knows not to treat one as a confirmed opening, and has a real Ontario talent pool with its deadline and requirements.
evidence: tiktok-research-2026-11-14 CONCEPTS #10 ('Talent pool' doesn't mean there's an opening)
pain_points.md #3 (not knowing what an extern posting means) and #2 (where/when to apply)

slides.title: what a talent pool means
slides.body: the hospital is building a pool of candidates for upcoming vacancies. it isn't one specific open position.

mark.phrase: it isn't one specific open position

slides.title: so what does that mean for you?
slides.body: if you qualify, you can still apply. just don't count it as a confirmed opening, and keep checking other postings too.

caption.text:
Not every externship posting means there’s an open job. Some are talent pools: the hospital builds a candidate pool for upcoming vacancies instead of filling one specific position.

Ontario example: Scarborough Health Network’s Clinical Nurse Extern talent pool closes Nov 30, 2026. BScN year 3 or final year, current BCLS, $25.379/hr (as posted). Full requirements are on SHN’s posting.

Have you come across a talent pool posting before?

ontarioexterns.ca is our own independent tracker of Ontario extern postings, checked on hospitals’ own career pages. Not affiliated with any hospital.
